title: E-Commerce Storefront
objective: Develop a product browsing and cart experience backed by an API.
scenario: Develop a product browsing and cart experience backed by an API. Build in increments, keep a written acceptance checklist, and verify one failure or boundary case per major workflow.

milestones.title: Product details, search, and sorting
acceptance_criteria: Product details, search, and sorting works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

milestones.title: Cart state and quantity updates
acceptance_criteria: Cart state and quantity updates works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

milestones.title: Validated checkout form
acceptance_criteria: Validated checkout form works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

milestones.title: Loading, empty, and error states
acceptance_criteria: Loading, empty, and error states works with reproducible steps and an expected result.
A relevant empty, invalid, loading, or failure state is handled where applicable.

stretch_features: Add test coverage for one additional boundary case.
Measure and document one performance or accessibility improvement.
tests_and_validation: Run the application in a local create-vue/Vite project.
Test keyboard-only interaction and responsive layouts.
Check console/network errors and the empty/failure paths.
Document the tested browser, runtime versions, and repeatable test steps.

rubric.criterion: Loading, error, empty, and boundary cases

review_method: Human review using the rubric. CodeLeaf does not execute the complete Vue project; include reproducible local test evidence.
status_note: Draft brief derived from the supplied Vue curriculum PDF; human review required before publication.
